reviews.review_title: Date the final straw with Temu
reviews.review_text:
Date: July 20, 2026
To: Corporate Management & Customer Service Leadership
Subject: Final Resolution and Demand to Cease Contact – Account/Reference No: [Insert Account or Ticket Number if you have one]
Good morning,
I am writing to formally demand an immediate conclusion to the ongoing dispute regarding the incident that began on May 16, 2026. This matter has involved an exhausting amount of back-and-forth communication, conflicting statements from multiple layers of management, and an unacceptable lack of internal alignment on your end—despite the extensive paperwork, proof, and bank statements provided.
Your investigation has established that the carrier took the property in question (the purple quilt). Despite this finding, I have faced continuous, inconsistent demands for more research time and a complete lack of accountability from your team.
Please consider this letter my formal directive to cease and desist all further investigation, collection efforts, or inquiries regarding this matter. It is time for this situation to end.
I am walking away from this dispute under the following strict terms:
Written Confirmation of Conclusion: I require a formal, written statement from management explicitly confirming that this matter is completely closed and that your company will not contact me regarding this issue again.
No False Attribution of Blame: The written confirmation must not state, imply, or suggest that I initiated an improper refund, that I am at fault, or that I caused this situation in any way. I will not accept a narrative that falsely shifts blame onto me to cover up internal or carrier failures.
Rejection of the $3.17 Settlement: The offered amount of $3.17 is entirely unacceptable given the distress and administrative burden this situation has caused. I reject this credit. Please donate that amount to a charity of your choice, as I want no part of it.
I am willing to close this chapter and move forward without further escalating this issue, provided you respect this demand to leave me alone. However, be advised that if I receive a closing statement that falsely accuses me of wrongdoing or attempts to misrepresent the facts, I will immediately hand over all of my documentation—including the extensive proof, timeline of inconsistencies, and contradictory statements from your management team—to outside parties for assistance.
Please issue the required, neutral written confirmation closing this file immediately.
Sincerely,

reviews.review_title: Temu offers a huge selection of…
reviews.review_text: Temu offers a huge selection of products at very low prices, which is its biggest advantage. However, the quality can be very inconsistent—some items are great, while others don't match the photos or descriptions. Shipping was acceptable but took longer than expected. The app is easy to use, but it can feel overwhelming with constant promotions and notifications. Overall, it's okay for inexpensive purchases if you keep your expectations realistic.

reviews.review_title: Misrepresentation and Abysmal Customer Service
reviews.review_text:
I am writing this public notice to highlight a severe failure by Temu regarding order fulfilment, consumer rights adherence, and customer support competence. 
I placed an order for a specific item, but the item delivered was entirely different from what was purchased. Upon immediately initiating a refund, I experienced a systemic failure in Temu's dispute resolution process: Deceptive Timelines: The automated system promised a merchant response within 1–3 business days. By the fourth day, no action had been taken. Direct communication with the seller yielded only identical, scripted, and empty promises. Failure to Provide Practicable Return Methods: Customer support insisted on emailing a printable return label. I explicitly informed an agent that I do not own printing facilities, and that the parcel's dimensions exceed my cars capacity. These logistical barriers were completely ignored. 

Evasive Delay Tactics: The resolution window was unilaterally extended from the advertised 1–3 business days to an unacceptable 9 business days. I was rigidly told to wait until 25th July just to contact them again, a tactic clearly designed to dismiss the consumer rather than resolve the issue. Temu’s customer service operates on rigid, automated scripts completely detached from practical problem-solving. A simple error has been dragged out unnecessarily due to corporate incompetence. Potential customers should be heavily cautioned: if your order is incorrect, expect zero meaningful support and exhausting delays. I demand that Temu immediately contact me to arrange a courier collection at their expense—requiring no printed label—and issue a full refund.

reviews.review_title: very disappointed with the overall experience.
reviews.review_text:
I am a loyal Temu customer, but my experience has become increasingly disappointing.

My recent orders 
PO-004-12184301901432094 and 
PO-004-01189241119352094 
have once again suffered from long delivery delays. Unfortunately, this is not an isolated incident—it has happened with many of my previous orders as well.

What is even more frustrating is that I have also received damaged items and products that did not match their descriptions. In those cases, I was often required to return the items before receiving a refund, while I have seen many other customers receive refunds or compensation without having to go through the same process.

This inconsistent treatment makes me feel that customers are not treated equally. Loyal customers should not have to repeatedly experience delayed deliveries, damaged or inaccurate products, and a much more difficult refund process than others.
To make matters worse, Temu promised me a 5$ compensation, I accepted the offer, but I never received it. Making promises and then failing to honor them has seriously damaged my trust in Temu's customer service.

I hope Temu will review its customer service policies, ensure fair treatment for all customers, improve delivery reliability, and handle compensation requests consistently. At the moment, I am very disappointed with the overall experience.
